EU Proposes 22nd Russia Sanctions Package Targeting Crypto Platforms and 60 Banks

European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced on November 23 a proposed 22nd sanctions package against Russia, seeking to extend transaction bans to approximately 60 Russian banks and remove them from the SWIFT system. The proposal also targets cryptocurrency platforms and payment networks in Russia and third countries facilitating sanctions evasion. Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director

Nvidia said Jensen Huang has been reinstated as president, CEO and a board director effective immediately after a unanimous board vote. The board said input from senior U.S. government officials gave it confidence that his return poses no national security risk, while an independent investigation into recent foreign-intelligence-related reports will continue.

Nvidia shares surged as much as 25% in premarket trading Monday after plunging 14% on Friday to $125.53, near an 18-month low. — link

BitMine said it acquired 7,819 ETH over the past week, bringing total holdings to 6,085,564 ETH, or about 4.98% of Ethereum’s supply. The company has 5,227,037 ETH staked, generating projected annualized staking revenue of about $245 million; fully staking its ETH holdings could raise that to roughly $286 million at its current 2.74% seven-day yield.
